name: Dr. Imogen Ashdown
bio: Imogen opened Merriwold in 2014 in the old bank building on Ferry Street. She does most of the crowns and root canals, and she still answers the phone when the front desk is busy.
summary: Owner. Crowns, root canals and the long talk before either.

name: Dr. Rafael Okonkwo-Reyes
focus: Dental implant,Wisdom tooth removal,Simple extraction,Toothache or broken tooth
bio: Rafael places implants and takes out the wisdom teeth that need to come out. He spent six years in a hospital oral surgery department before joining the practice.
summary: Implants, wisdom teeth and Thursday emergencies.

name: Dr. Lena Vartanian
bio: Lena plans every aligner case from a 3D scan and sees patients two days a week. She is also the person to ask about grinding and night guards.

name: Priya Halloran
bio: Priya has cleaned teeth in Tansey Ford for fifteen years and measures gums more gently than anyone. She runs the deep cleaning program.
summary: Cleanings, gums and the patient who has not been in for years.

name: Tomasz Wierzbicki
bio: Tomasz sees most of the practice's children, and the Saturday-morning adults who cannot get away during the week.

name: June Castellanos
bio: June writes up every treatment plan with an estimate and checks it with your insurer before anything is booked. Before that, she was a dental assistant for ten years.
